newsitem.title: USA: Engelhard names Perry as president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Engelhard names Perry as president, COO.

text.p: Engelhard Corp said Tuesday that Barry Perry, currently group vice president and general manager of the Pigments and Additives Group, has been elected president and chief operating officer, succeeding L. Donald LaTorre, who has chosen to retire effective April 1.

The company also announced that Joseph Gonnella, group vice president and general manager of Engelhard's Environmental Technologies Group, has been elected senior vice president, strategy and corporate development. Perry and Gonnella will report directly to Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Orin Smith.
